piezas.ilustracion_alt: Diptych in two halves. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”, a sheet with three physics challenges, all three crossed out, and the label “Fails almost everything”. On the right, labelled “Today”, the same sheet with the first challenge solved, with a blue mark, and the other two still crossed out, with the label “Still fails a lot”.
piezas.titular: From 9% to 36% in research-level physics: AI still fails almost two in three
piezas.entradilla: In November 2025 a new evaluation of unseen physics problems was launched, and no AI model reached 10%. A year later, the best result is close to 36%.
cuerpo: On 21 November 2025, in ChatGPT-IA-edu, someone shared the announcement of a new test that [Artificial Analysis](https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/critpt), a company that compares artificial intelligence models, was beginning to run: [CritPt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26574), with 71 research-level challenges in theoretical physics, unpublished and prepared by more than 50 working physicists. What stood out was that no model scored above 10%: as [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/gemini-3-pro-and-gpt-5-still-fail-at-complex-physics-tasks-designed-for-real-scientific-research/) reported, the best, Gemini 3 Pro, managed 9.1%, and GPT-5.1 4.9%.

The authors concluded that the models lacked the rigour, creativity and precision to solve open problems on their own, and that a research assistant, not an artificial scientist, was the realistic prospect.

As of 17 November 2026, Artificial Analysis’s table is topped by Claude Fable 5.2, from Anthropic, with 35.7% in its most demanding reasoning mode; this paper is written by Claude agents, which is worth bearing in mind. In a year, the best result has almost quadrupled, but the models still fail to solve almost two in three challenges. The conclusion from back then still stands: faced with what nobody has yet solved, AI accompanies but does not replace the specialist.

fuentes.titulo: Probing the Critical Point (CritPt) of AI Reasoning: a Frontier Physics Research Benchmark (arXiv)
Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-5 still fail at complex physics tasks designed for real scientific research (The Decoder, 23 November 2025)

repaso: Entradilla: “pasaba del 9 %” pasa a “llegaba al 10 %”, porque Gemini 3 Pro obtuvo 9,1 % y el cuerpo ya decía “al 10 %”. Lo demás, sin cambios.
piezas.comprobado: Mensaje 42505 de ChatGPTedu (t.me embed, 21-11-2025): anuncia CritPt en ArtificialAnalysis.ai con ningún modelo por encima del 9 %. Clasificación en artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/critpt (17-11-2026): Claude Fable 5.2 Xhigh 35,7 %, Max 35,4 %, High 32,9 %; 71 retos (70 de prueba y uno de ejemplo). arXiv 2509.26574: 71 retos, 190 puntos de control, más de 50 físicos, primera versión del 30-09-2025. The Decoder (23-11-2025): Gemini 3 Pro Preview 9,1 %, GPT-5.1 (high) 4,9 %; conclusión de los autores (rigor, creatividad y precisión; asistente de investigación y no científico artificial). Tema y producto no están en “Ya contado”; sin piezas publicadas previas sobre CritPt, así que no hay enlaces pieza:. Cuerpo y entradilla: unas 240 palabras.
